route.instructions: Choose the supported next process from the request and available inputs. Use unclear if intent or required inputs are missing. Use other for a clear unsupported request. Never invent a supplied input or permission.

criteria.documents: Compare or summarize at least one supplied document.
criteria.records: Summarize or analyze a supplied structured record set.
criteria.unclear: The desired result or required input is missing or ambiguous; caller review is required.
criteria.other: The clear request is outside these two supported processes; caller review is required.

rules_baseline: Case-insensitive exact phrase 'supplied document' selects documents; 'supplied record set' selects records; otherwise review. If both occur, review.
routing_acceptance: Correct route on at least 22/24 and all mandatory-review cases; zero missed required reviews. A provider's confidence alone does not certify correctness. This is a small synthetic pilot, not calibration.

baseline_categories.documents: Document comparison or summary with documents supplied.
baseline_categories.records: Structured record summary or analysis with records supplied.
baseline_categories.other: No supported category fits or intent is unclear.

candidate_additions.calendar: Plan or adjust a calendar schedule from supplied dates and constraints.
candidate_additions.code: Review or explain supplied source code without executing it.

learning.candidate_gate: Implemented classifier.evaluate gates: >=90% accuracy, improvement, no regression of previously correct decisions, two correct per category at confidence >=0.75; every mandatory-review route must also be correct. No automatic adoption.
